commons_claim: Drel hunts Cassik when temperature is at most 22°C OR drel_density is at least 35; otherwise it does not hunt.
evidence_summary: All six confirmed observations fit this rule exactly: hunting occurs at (22,35), (21,44), and (20,40), while no hunting occurs at (22,28), (23,60), and (24,70). SOURCE_A was more reliable than SOURCE_B in calibration (7/8 versus 4/8), and Packet 1 was more consistent with the confirmed pattern than Packet 2.

final_output.rationale: The confirmed cases require an inclusive low-temperature condition and an inclusive density condition joined by OR. The ancestral AND rule is contradicted by hunting at density 35 with temperature 22 and at temperature 21 with density 44, while plausible threshold alternatives fail to fit the boundary cases.
